title: A dose–response curve
caption: E = 100C/(2 + C) rises steeply and then saturates at E_max = 100%. At C = EC₅₀ = 2 mg/L the effect is 50%, and at C = 6 mg/L it is 75%.
alt: A saturating curve of effect against concentration, passing 50 percent at 2 milligrams per litre and 75 percent at 6, levelling towards 100 percent.
description: With E_max = 100% and EC₅₀ = 2 mg/L the effect is E = 100C/(2 + C).
At C = 2 mg/L the effect is half of E_max: 50%.
The curve approaches 100% but never reaches it.

checks.name: at C = EC₅₀ the effect is E_max/2
